quests.title: The Stranded Garrison
quests.description: Watchwarden Kelgrim has held this post at the edge of Tiragarde Keep for longer than he likes to admit. The humans washed up here years back - Kul Tiras sailors, shipwrecked or marooned, nobody's ever gotten a straight answer out of the survivors before putting them down. They dug in. Built walls out of the ruin's old stones. Now they raid the coast road when they're hungry, which is often. Kelgrim doesn't call them monsters - he's careful about that word, more careful than you'd expect from an orc who's killed his share of them. He calls them 'the stranded' and he says it like it costs him something. Thin their numbers at the outer wall - marines, deckhands, whoever's standing watch. Leave their captain for later. Kelgrim wants to talk about him separately, and he made that very clear.
quests.accept_text: Eight of them, whichever kind you find first - marines, deckhands, the ones with the long rifles up on the wall. They'll fight like people who know they're already dead men walking, because in every way that matters to them, they are. Don't mistake desperate for weak. And don't go near the one who commands them. Not yet. We'll talk about him when you're done here.
quests.turn_in_text: Eight down. Good. You didn't hesitate, which tells me something about you, though I couldn't say what yet. Sit a moment before you go back in. There's still the matter of their captain, and that conversation deserves more than me shouting it at you between sword-swings.

quests.title: The Line You Cross
quests.description: Captain Thalenvorde commands what's left of the Tiragarde garrison, and Kelgrim has been putting off this conversation since you first walked up to his post. Thalenvorde is a person. Not a boar, not a demon summoned out of some tear in the world's fabric that was never going to have a name if you hadn't asked - a person, with a rank and a crew and, however he ended up here, a life before this island that Kelgrim suspects looked ordinary once. Kelgrim has killed enough of the stranded to stop feeling the weight of it years ago. He watches you carefully as he says this next part, like he's trying to remember what it was like the first time, for him. Killing a beast doesn't ask anything of you. Killing a person does, whether or not you asked to fall into a world where the second one is suddenly on the table. He isn't going to talk you out of it. The garrison won't stop raiding while Thalenvorde commands it, and that's reason enough by the only math that matters out here. But he wanted you to walk in understanding exactly what you're about to do, instead of finding out after. That's the only kindness he has to offer you today.
quests.accept_text: I won't pretend this is the same as the boars in the valley, or the demons in that cave you cleared out as a green recruit. Thalenvorde bleeds like you do. He probably has people somewhere who'd grieve him, the way people back on your blue planet would grieve you, if news like that could even reach them anymore. None of that changes what has to happen. It just means you should know what you're carrying afterward. Go. Finish it. And however it sits with you when it's done - that's not weakness. That's just what it costs, the first time. Every time after this one gets a little quieter. I'm not sure if that's supposed to be a comfort.
quests.turn_in_text: It's done, then. I can see it on you, the particular quiet that comes after - I remember mine, if you can believe an orc admitting that. Thalenvorde won't be leading raids on the coast road anymore, and the valley's a little safer for it. That part's true, and it matters. Keep what you took off him. Wear it. Not as a trophy - as a reminder, if you need one, of exactly where you stand now. You crossed a line today that doesn't uncross. Most people out here crossed it a long time before you fell into this world. Now you know what it actually weighs. That's not nothing, and I won't pretend it is.

unique_item_defs.name: Blood-Soaked Wraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: No amount of scrubbing will truly clean these threads, but you tighten the wraps anyway—there is no turning back now.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Blood-Soaked Grips
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The warmth of their life faded against your palm, leaving behind a cold grip and a steel-hardened resolve.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Blood-Soaked Handguards
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Iron rings absorb the crimson stain, a silent armor for hands that have crossed a line they can never uncross.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail (Agi/Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Blood-Soaked Gauntlets
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Steel conceals the blood on your fingers, armoring not just your hands, but the quiet resolve growing within you.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate (Str)

quests.title: Ashgrym's Old Enemy
quests.description: Bloodwarden Ashgrym has been watching Skull Rock for longer than he's willing to put a number on. The Burning Blade Coven cut into back in the valley wasn't the whole cult - just the part that wandered too far from its real nest. Skull Rock is the nest. Searing Blade scouts and raiders patrol the approach, and Ashgrym wants them cleared before anyone goes near the cave mouth. He's fought this cult before. He doesn't talk about how that went.
quests.accept_text: Clear the approach first. I mean that as an order, not a suggestion - the cave itself is worse, and I'd rather you walk in without half the patrol already alerted. Ten of them. Don't rush it.
quests.turn_in_text: The approach is quiet. It won't stay that way once you go into the cave itself - nothing about Skull Rock stays quiet for long - but you've earned the right to try. Two names matter once you're inside: Neru Fireblade and Gazz'uz. Neither of them will make this easy.

quests.title: Fireblade
quests.description: Neru Fireblade holds rank inside Skull Rock through fire and force of will, in roughly that order. Ashgrym describes her the way you'd describe a wound that never fully closed - present tense, personal, unresolved. She commands the Searing Blade enforcers and warlocks who guard the cave's outer chambers, and she will not be reasoned with.
quests.accept_text: She fights with fire and she fights smart, which is a worse combination than either alone. Don't stand still. Whatever else you do in that fight, don't stand still.
quests.turn_in_text: Neru's gone. I won't pretend that's simple for me to hear - old business, older than you'd guess to look at me. Gazz'uz is still down there, and he's the real reason this cave has never actually closed for good. He's not orc, or troll, or anything that bleeds the way we do. Be ready for that.

unique_item_defs.name: Fireblade's Cooling Ember
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Still warm to the touch, days later. You suspect it always will be.
unique_item_defs.label: Off-Hand (Int)

quests.title: What the Cave Was Guarding
quests.description: Gazz'uz is a demon, and Ashgrym is very deliberate about using that word instead of any softer one. Not a person who crossed a line, not a beast that got too big - something summoned, tearing at the world from somewhere that isn't supposed to touch it. This is the real reason Skull Rock has never fully closed. Kill it, and the cave is finally just a cave again.
quests.accept_text: This one doesn't bleed the way Neru did, and it won't stop the way a person stops. Everything about it is wrong in a way I don't have good words for. Kill it anyway. That's the job, whether or not I can explain what it actually is.
quests.turn_in_text: It's over. Skull Rock is just rock now, no cult, no demon, nothing left down there but the echo of what used to be. I've wanted this day for longer than you've been in this world, and I mean that far more literally than you probably assume. Whatever that thing was carrying is yours. Take it and don't look back at that cave mouth on your way out.

unique_item_defs.name: Gazz'uz's Unmaking
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It doesn't feel like a weapon so much as a wound in the shape of one. You're not entirely sure the demon is done with it.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Warden's Closure
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Ashgrym pressed this into your hand himself, and didn't say anything else. He didn't need to.
unique_item_defs.label: Neck (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Feathers for the Ledger
quests.description: Gazlowe's Cousin Fitz has a buyer back in Orgrimmar who pays well for sunbaked vulture feathers - something about fletching contracts, though Fitz admits he's never actually asked what they're for. He just knows the going rate, and the going rate is good enough that he's willing to pay a finder's cut to anyone willing to brave the Red Wastes and actually collect them.
quests.accept_text: Eight feathers, good condition, no scorch marks - the buyer's picky about scorch marks for some reason I've genuinely never asked about. Just bring me eight and I'll cut you in fair.
quests.turn_in_text: Perfect condition, all eight. I don't know what a fletcher in Orgrimmar wants with this many vulture feathers and honestly at this point I've stopped wondering. Here's your cut.

quests.title: Scouting the Prowler Den
quests.description: Borka the Watchful has noticed the Durotar prowlers denning closer to the road than usual, and he'd rather know exactly where before Razor Hill sends anyone in after them properly. The cats have made a den in the dry basin west of the highway, roughly halfway between the Orgrimmar gate and Razor Hill. He's not asking for a fight yet - just eyes on the den itself, confirmed and reported back.
quests.accept_text: North of here, in the dry basin west of the highway, about halfway to the Orgrimmar gate. Get close enough to confirm the den and get out. I'd rather have a live scout with an answer than a dead hero with a guess.
quests.turn_in_text: Good. Now we actually know where they've dug in instead of guessing from droppings and torn-up ground. That's worth more to me than another dead prowler would've been.

quests.title: Eyes on the Road
quests.description: The Outrider at the gate watches the highway for a living, and for three weeks the highway has been watching back. Rustfang hyenas have started tailing the caravans out of Orgrimmar, hanging a hundred paces behind the last wagon and picking off whatever falls behind. Wagons are late. Drivers are quitting. The Outrider would deal with it herself, but the gate is hers to hold, and someone has to be seen to be doing something.
quests.accept_text: Out on the Red Wastes, either side of the highway. They come in threes and fours, rust-red, grinning like they know something. They do not know anything. Make that clear to them.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer of them on the road already - I can hear it. Quiet, I mean. There's a bigger one, though. The drivers talk about him like he's a tax collector. Take this and keep your eyes open.

unique_item_defs.name: Outrider's Roadcloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Dust-coloured on the outside. The inside is mostly pockets.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Gate-Watch Brigandine
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Standard issue for the gate. Fits almost nobody exactly.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Chest (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Wasteland Spear
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A long spear for short tempers.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Hyena-Tooth Ring
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Strung on a leather thong; the thong has seen worse days.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Wanted: Old Redtooth
quests.description: Every pack has a head, and the Rustfang's is a hyena the drivers call Old Redtooth. Scarred muzzle, one ear torn to a notch, bigger than a pony and smarter than most of the guards at the gate. He doesn't charge. He circles, he waits, he lets the others bleed you first. The Outrider has a bounty on him that's older than some of the recruits.
quests.accept_text: He keeps to the open ground off the highway, not far from the gate road. Don't fight him with your back to a hill - he'll have two friends up there before you finish the thought.
quests.turn_in_text: That's the notch, right there. Redtooth's done. Good. Keep the pelt if you want, but I think you'll want what he guarded.

unique_item_defs.name: Redtooth's Fang-Knife
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Pulled from the jaw of the alpha himself. Still thinks it's hunting.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi/Hit/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Rustfang Hunter's Mask
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Hyena-hide stitched around a skull that did not need it any more.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Helm (Agi/Int/AP)

unique_item_defs.name: Pack-Mother's Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Every pack has someone who keeps the others alive. This is what she wore.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Healing/MP5)

unique_item_defs.name: Hauberk of the Alpha
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Layers of hide and scale. It shrugs off teeth with a sort of smug patience.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Chest (Str/Agi/Sta)

quests.title: Scorpid Season
quests.description: The Sentry's patrol cuts across the east side of the highway and every year around this time the armored scorpids come out from under their rocks to mate, or fight, or - he's honestly never been clear which. What he is clear on is that his boots are not made for it. Thin them out before they spread to the road.
quests.accept_text: Out past the road, near the rock shelves. The plates are thick, so hit the gaps. They don't hunt you. They just don't move out of your way.
quests.turn_in_text: Quieter already. I'll be able to walk the whole beat in peace for a week. Take something from the stores - Orgrimmar won't miss it, and if it does, it'll blame me.

unique_item_defs.name: Scorpid-Plate Pauldrons
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Sections of scorpid carapace on a plate frame. They clack when you shrug.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Shoulders (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Sentry's Quilted Wraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Padded cloth, because even sentries get tired of bruises.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Int/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Tail-Stinger Dirk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A scorpid tail-spine on a hilt. It's better than it sounds.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Carapace Buckler
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Small, round, and a little bit venomous looking.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Sta)

quests.title: A Warm Blanket
quests.description: Grosk the Wanderer has crossed the Wastes more times than he can count and has never once been cold, which is why it took him three nights to notice that Grukk's boy is. The desert freezes after dark, and the child has been sleeping on a bedroll thin enough to read through. Prowler pelts are the warmest thing for a hundred miles. Grosk has too many knees to hunt them himself.
quests.accept_text: Durotar Prowlers - the big sand-coloured cats. They den in the rough ground west of the highway. Six good pelts, no holes in them. The boy's small, but he's not that small.
quests.turn_in_text: Look at that. He's asleep already and I haven't even tucked it in. You've done a better thing than most do all year. I'll not be needing this anymore - the road gave it to me, and it gave you a better deal.

unique_item_defs.name: Wanderer's Prowlerhide Vest
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Warm on a cold night. Smells like campfire and apology.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Roadworn Walking Staff
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Has walked further than you will. Has opinions on the matter.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Sta/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Kid's Lucky Pebble
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A smooth river-stone painted with a face. The face is smiling at something behind you.
unique_item_defs.label: Trinket (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Dustproof Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Seams sealed with something sticky and mysterious.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Boots (Str/Spi)

quests.title: The Rumble Below
quests.description: Ridgewatch Kurr has watched Thunder Ridge for years and the ridge has never been this loud. Thunder lizards and their cousins the thunderhides are wandering down off the slopes in numbers, crowding the approach to the cave and snapping at anyone who gets between them and the water. He wants the traffic thinned before something worse follows them down.
quests.accept_text: North-west of the highway, up the gravel basin. You'll hear them before you see them. If the ground hums, step to the side. Seriously.
quests.turn_in_text: Better. Not good, but better. You noticed the other ones up there, though - the ones that talk? That's the real problem. Finish what you started.

unique_item_defs.name: Ridgewatcher's Hauberk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Mail layered over ridge-lizard scale. It doesn't mind the weather.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Chest (Str/Sta/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Static-Charged Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Rub them together and the hairs on your arms agree.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Gloves (Int/SP/MP5)

unique_item_defs.name: Gravel-Runner Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Grip the loose stone so you don't have to.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Boots (Agi/Sta/Hit)

unique_item_defs.name: Thunderhide Girdle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Thick, stiff, and only a little bit singed.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Belt (Str/Sta/Defense)

quests.title: Stormbinders
quests.description: The lizards aren't coming down on their own. Something has been feeding the storm on the ridge - Kurr has watched Ridge Stormbinders chanting at the cliff edge with their arms raised, and every time they finish, a flock of static hatchlings spills out of the rocks. Whatever they're building toward, he doesn't want to be there for it.
quests.accept_text: Higher up the ridge, where the rock goes dark. Take the binders first - the hatchlings stop swarming when the chanting stops. Don't stand in anything that's glowing.
quests.turn_in_text: Quiet. Truly quiet. Which means he's awake. Rumblejaw - the big one. I've never seen him come down, but I've heard him through the stone.

unique_item_defs.name: Stormbinder's Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Woven from a binder's own cloak, singed at the hem.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Int/SP/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Hatchling-Shell Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Light, hard, and still faintly crackling.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Bracers (Sta/Agi/Dodge)

unique_item_defs.name: Lightning-Rod Spear
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Do not hold this during a storm. Do not hold this ever, if you can help it.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Str/Hit/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Tempest Ward Band
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A ring of fused sand. It repels lightning like a bad idea.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Sta/Defense/Dodge)

quests.title: Wanted: Rumblejaw
quests.description: There's a lizard on Thunder Ridge the length of two ox-carts with a jaw that cracks stone. The scouts call him Rumblejaw because they feel him before they hear him. He's never been seen beyond the high shelves, but Kurr says that's changing: the stormbinders have been feeding him. Cut the head off the problem.
quests.accept_text: Top of the ridge, in the rock shelf above the basin. When the ground stops shaking, he's about to hit you. Move when it stops, not when it starts.
quests.turn_in_text: Rumblejaw's down? I can hear the quiet from here. That's the first real silence the ridge has had in ten years. Take whatever fits.

unique_item_defs.name: Rumblejaw's Slab
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A plate of fused ridge-stone. Rattles, faintly, when something big walks by.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Sta/Block)

unique_item_defs.name: Thunderbitten Staff
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The wood is petrified. The lightning it holds is not.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int/SP/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Seer's Stoneplate Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Slate bracers. Listen to them and you can hear the ridge settling.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Bracers (Int/Sta/MP5)

unique_item_defs.name: Quake-Walker's Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Heavy plates that don't care how the ground feels about it.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Legs (Str/Sta/Crit)

quests.title: Cinders on the Wind
quests.description: The Skull Rock Watcher has stood on the cliff above the approach for so long he's stopped seeing the ash, but today it's coming up the path in clouds. Burning Blade torchbearers are burning their way across the approach to clear ground for something, and a swarm of cinder imps follows them to feed on the embers. If that fire reaches the road, the Wastes are going to burn for a week.
quests.accept_text: Down the cliff path, toward the cave mouth. Torchbearers first - they light everything they pass. The imps are small, but they're quick, and they bite where you least expect.
quests.turn_in_text: The wind's clean for the first time since spring. I could cry. I won't, but I could. There's a man down there with dogs - Kraygh. He lit the first fire. Finish it.

unique_item_defs.name: Ash-Walker's Wraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Fireproofed with something that doesn't smell as bad as it ought to.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Torchbearer's Cord
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Singed in a few places. Strong in all the rest.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Belt (Str/Sta/Hit)

unique_item_defs.name: Cinderproof Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Ash slides off it. So does a lot of other things.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Sta/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Imp-Bone Cudgel
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Small, ugly, and fond of finding the soft spot.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str/Agi)

quests.title: The Houndmaster
quests.description: Houndmaster Kraygh keeps his dogs on the approach and his whip in his hand and he's never once been seen sleeping. The Burning Blade bring him fresh hounds from the caves and he sets them on any traveler who looks too far in. He's good with a whip. He's better with an excuse. The Watcher wants him gone before the hounds find a way down to the road.
quests.accept_text: Down by the cave mouth, with his pack. Cut the guards down first - they hold the hounds back until he gives the word. When the whip cracks, run. Not away. Past him.
quests.turn_in_text: The whip's silent. Do you hear that? Nothing's barking. Take his things. He won't be wanting them.

unique_item_defs.name: Kraygh's Felwhip Wand
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The leather's burned into the grip. It cracks even when you're not holding it.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand (Shadow Power)

unique_item_defs.name: Houndmaster's Fel-Pistol
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Fires something that mends the hounds. You've just decided it mends you instead.
unique_item_defs.label: Gun (Healing/MP5)

unique_item_defs.name: Kennel-Keeper's Plate
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Spiked and scorched in all the places a hound likes to bite.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Chest (Sta/Armor/Parry)

unique_item_defs.name: Netherfire Handwraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: They glow when the dark is close. They're glowing now.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Gloves (Shadow+Fire Power)

quests.title: All That Glitters
quests.description: Gazlowe's Cousin Fitz has been mapping the mesas for ore for six months and has found exactly one thing: the stonebiters chew it. Big rock-coloured beasts that gnaw on the mesa edges and, somewhere in that long digestive tract, concentrate glittering ore. Fitz would love to know how. He'd love it more if someone brought him a sample without making him go near the teeth.
quests.accept_text: Mesa Stonebiters. Big, grey, hungry. They drop little glittering chunks when you cut them open - yes, I know how that sounds. Six chunks. I'll pay a finder's cut and not ask questions.
quests.turn_in_text: Oh, that's lovely. It's practically jewelry. Don't tell Gazlowe, he'll want a cut. Here - and take one of my spare prospecting finds for your trouble.

unique_item_defs.name: Prospector's Greatcoat
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Pockets inside pockets. Most of them contain pebbles.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Fitz's Pick-Hammer
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Half pick, half hammer. Entirely sure which half it prefers.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Glittering Ore Pendant
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Ore, wire, and an optimistic goblin's idea of jewelry.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/SP/Hit)

unique_item_defs.name: Mesa-Stride Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Stout, scuffed, and quite fond of a good scramble.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Legs (Sta/Defense/Dodge)

quests.title: Hands on the Farm
quests.description: Borka the Watchful keeps one eye on the road and the other on Rocktusk Farm, where the quilboar have taken over a stolen homestead and put the previous owners' razorbacks to work. The farmhands are quilboar who've learned that a pitchfork works on people. The tamed razorbacks have learned much the same. Neither is a good neighbor.
quests.accept_text: South-west, through the gate in the farm palisade. The farmhands patrol the furrows; the razorbacks follow whoever's holding the slops. Don't be holding the slops.
quests.turn_in_text: Farm's quieter. Mostly. There's a sow in the back barn - the Matron. She's been breeding war-pigs in there since spring. I want her to stop.

unique_item_defs.name: Hog-Tender's Jerkin
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Greasy leather, but it takes a gore like a champion.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Str/Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Pitchfork of Leaning
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Hay-tipped and angry.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Furrow-Cleat Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Clay-caked, but they hold the dirt.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Boots (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Thornwood Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Wrapped with thorn-vine and a reasonable amount of luck.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Int/Spi)

quests.title: Wanted: Matron Sowbelly
quests.description: She was an ordinary sow once, the farm's breeding stock, before the quilboar fed her whatever it is they feed things. Now she's the size of a cart and twice as bitter. The razorbacks follow her. The farmhands pray to her. Borka wants her gone before she decides the road is next.
quests.accept_text: Farm barn, back of the furrows. She hits hard and she smells worse. Don't fight her in the open - the razorbacks will join in.
quests.turn_in_text: Matron's down. That's a lot of bacon, though I wouldn't touch it. Take the good stuff - she's done with it.

unique_item_defs.name: Farmyard Tenderiser
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A fence-post with ideas. The Matron had opinions about fences.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str/Sta/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Sowbelly's Silk Shawl
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Somebody wove this for a farmer's wife. She never got to wear it.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Int/Spi/Healing)

unique_item_defs.name: Matron's Ear-Tag
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Iron, numbered, and still warm. She was number one.
unique_item_defs.label: Trinket (Sta/Defense/Dodge)

unique_item_defs.name: Trough-Scrapers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Plate gauntlets, dented in a way that only makes sense if you have met the Matron.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Gloves (Str/Sta/Defense)

quests.title: Net and Hook
quests.description: Sylthressa Windmourne imports silk from places with names she says better than you could. She also imports it, regrettably, through Scuttle Coast, where the murlocs have taken to stringing nets across the beach and the saltcrust crabs have taken to living in them. Her caravans arrive late, tangled, and mildly crab-flavored. She would like this to stop.
quests.accept_text: East, on the shore. The netcasters throw first and ask questions never. The crabs just pinch. Clear both out and my silk can arrive dry.
quests.turn_in_text: Dry silk! You've no idea what that means to me. And there's something else on that coast - a murloc with a hook. My drivers call him the Net-Cutter. Please do him next.

unique_item_defs.name: Windmourne Silk Hood
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Finest weave, finest threads. She's very particular about the threads.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Helm (Int/SP/MP5)

unique_item_defs.name: Saltcrust Pauldrons
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Crab-shell on a plate frame. Sea air hasn't touched it.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Shoulders (Str/Sta/Hit)

unique_item_defs.name: Netweaver's Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Knots tied by hands that knew what they were doing.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Gloves (Agi/Int/AP)

unique_item_defs.name: Tidepool Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A pearl and a wish, bound in kelp.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Sta/Int/Healing)

quests.title: Wanted: Gillfin the Net-Cutter
quests.description: Every murloc tribe has one who learned to use a blade, and on Scuttle Coast it's Gillfin. He cuts nets, he cuts lines, and when he's bored, he cuts the traders' ropes. Sylthressa's drivers swear he took a wagon wheel once, for the hub. She'd like him out of business.
quests.accept_text: Shoreline, east. He moves between the netted rocks, and he'll mend himself if you let him. Don't.
quests.turn_in_text: The Net-Cutter is done? Gods. I could kiss you. I won't - business first - but I will pay you extremely well in finery.

unique_item_defs.name: Net-Cutter's Hooked Blade
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Half a sword, half a gaff. Entirely sure which half it prefers.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword (Dodge/Parry)

unique_item_defs.name: Driftwood Harpoon-Crossbow
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Fires harpoons. The harpoons are mostly spite.
unique_item_defs.label: Crossbow (Agi/Sta/Hit)

unique_item_defs.name: Tidewrack Wristwraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Dry-rotted netting, enchanted by someone with a long memory of drowning.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Int/SP/Hit)

unique_item_defs.name: Pearl of the Net-Cutter
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Pried from a clam that took it personally.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/SP/MP5)

quests.title: Kolkar Reckoning
quests.description: Wyll Marrow was a cartwright out of Stormwind when the Kolkar took his caravan at the Crag and left him alive as an afterthought. The Horde found him two days later, half-starved and swearing, and he's never quite forgiven them for the rescue or the centaur for the ambush. Now he wants the war-riders paid back, in the only currency they understand.
quests.accept_text: The Crag's the bowl south-west of the Barrens road. They ride in circles like they own it. Fair enough - they do. Thin the war-riders out and I'll sleep easier.
quests.turn_in_text: There. Somewhere in a Stormwind graveyard, my brother's smiling. There's one of them I can't get out of my head - a lame one with a limp he hides. Bloodhoof. He broke my wagon.

unique_item_defs.name: Cartwright's Steel Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cartwright's hands, steel gauntlets, a very patient maker.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Gloves (Str/Hit/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Marrow's Mended Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A cloak he's patched so often it's more patch than cloak.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Sta/Agi/Dodge)

unique_item_defs.name: Centaur-Hide Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Tough, supple, and cut for someone who never sits still.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Legs (Agi/Int/AP)

unique_item_defs.name: Wagon-Spoke Staff
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A broken spoke, carved and varnished. Quite a lot of care went into it.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int/SP/Crit)

quests.title: Wanted: Bloodhoof the Lamed
quests.description: The Kolkar tell stories about their outriders, and about the one called Bloodhoof they tell quieter. A crippled rider with a withered foreleg who kept charging anyway, long after any sensible centaur would have retired. He has taken more caravans than the rest of the Crag combined. Wyll wants him on his back, in the dust, where he put the wagons.
quests.accept_text: He rides alone, at the edge of the Crag, where the ground drops. He hits like a cart and runs like a deer. Don't chase him. Make him come to you.
quests.turn_in_text: Lamed Bloodhoof's down. I almost feel for him. Almost. Take whatever he carried - he won't be riding again.

unique_item_defs.name: Lamed Outrider's Glaive
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Balanced for a rider with one good leg. Rides on regardless.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Str/Hit/Crit)

unique_item_defs.name: Outrider's Hunting Belt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A Kolkar belt, studded with the tags of every kill he refused to stop counting.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Belt (Agi/Int/AP)

unique_item_defs.name: Hoofbeat Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: You can feel a gallop in the soles. Even standing still.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Boots (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Wrangler's Mending Band
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The ring he used on wounded mounts. It did a lot of mending, in the end.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Healing/MP5)

quests.title: Last Words
quests.description: The bones by the shore are a wagon-driver's, and clutched in them is a sealed letter and a cracked signet ring that doesn't look like it belongs to the driver. The letter is addressed to someone named Tamsin, care of the burnt caravan on the highway south-west of Grosk's camp. The ink's too faded to say who's expecting it. It doesn't say it has to be delivered. But somebody has to.
quests.accept_text: (The bones don't speak. The letter is addressed in a shaky hand, and the ring is warm in your palm.) The highway south-west of the traveler's camp. Where the wagons burned.
quests.turn_in_text: (You lay the letter among the ash, as best you can. When you return, the signet is a little less cracked than it was. The wind carries something that might be thanks.)

unique_item_defs.name: Driver's Signet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A plain ring, polished smooth by an owner who wore it every day.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Sta/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Wagon-Wheel Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Small enough to hold, heavy enough to remember.
unique_item_defs.label: Trinket (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Tamsin's Last Letter
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Wax-sealed, unread. A little warm, somehow.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/Spi/Healing)

unique_item_defs.name: Roadmender's Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Worn through. Somehow still keeping their word.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Boots (Sta/Defense/Dodge)

quests.title: The Safe Road South
quests.description: Southbound Grekka has walked the road between Razor Hill and the Valley of Trials longer than most recruits have been alive. Lately she can't make it past the Rocktusk Farm turnoff without a quilboar scout shaking her down for the privilege. Recruits shouldn't have to start their first week on the Wastes with their coin purse already lighter.
quests.accept_text: The road south of the gateway, near the farm. The scouts watch from above; the geomancers throw rocks from behind. Take the geomancers first, if you can find them.
quests.turn_in_text: You're a good one. Now new recruits get a clean road and I get to keep what I earn. Here - a spare from my own pack.

unique_item_defs.name: Wayfarer's Longcoat
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Long enough to keep out the wind. Short enough to run in.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Roadkeeper's Mace
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A solid mace for solid people.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Grekka's Spare Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Thick wool, a little frayed at the hem.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Southbound Sash
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Tied around her waist for forty miles. It's earned its place.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Belt (Agi/Sta)

quests.title: Road Tax
quests.description: Wandering Bok sells what he can on the road between Razor Hill and the gate and pays the Orgrimmar road tax out of his own pocket. The quilboar have started doing the same - collecting it, that is. Their quilboar-sized toll pouches turn up in their packs every time someone's gotten past them, and Bok figures that's his coin. He'd like his coin.
quests.accept_text: Razormane quilboar, out on the Wastes. They carry leather pouches on their belts - you'll know them. Six pouches, and I'll consider the road tax paid.
quests.turn_in_text: My coin! Smaller than I remembered, but still mine. Now take a cut - you've earned it, and I always pay my debts.

unique_item_defs.name: Merchant's Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Sewn by someone who was careful about the seams.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Sta/Int/Healing)

unique_item_defs.name: Toll-Collector's Hauberk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Heavy mail with an extra layer of leather where the money goes.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Chest (Str/Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Strongbox Shield
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A lid with a lock, and a fair bit of dent.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Sta/Block)

unique_item_defs.name: Bok's Lucky Coin
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Heads, he wins. Tails, he's thinking about it.
unique_item_defs.label: Trinket (Agi/Int)
